title: Request path: who talks to whom
desc: The CRM and the model API are outside systems (dashed). Ingest pulls deals and notes, writes our copy; the extractor reads messages, asks the model, gets plausible JSON back and hands it to the validator; valid rows are inserted, failures recorded.

messages.label: Pull deals + notes
messages.say: Ingest pulls deals and notes from the CRM.

messages.label: Write our copy
messages.say: It writes our own copy, so every later step can retry and replay.

messages.label: Read messages
messages.say: The extractor reads a deal's messages from our store.

messages.label: Extract mentions
messages.say: It asks the model which assets were mentioned.

messages.label: Plausible JSON
messages.say: The model answers with plausible JSON: fluent, confident, sometimes wrong.

messages.label: safeParse()
messages.say: The answer crosses the boundary: safeParse() decides.

messages.label: Record reject
messages.say: Failures are recorded as rejects: visible, countable, reviewable.

footnote: Their CRM stays the source of truth for their data. Everything after ingest is ours to retry, replay and inspect.
